integrity: Proof and finite checker are separated. Analytic argument proves all dimensions, while rational code checks finitely many cases only. External independent validation is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Euclidean regular simplices of dimensions d≥3, two equal-radius closed balls with unrestricted centers; no result for arbitrary simplices or 3+ covering balls. Even-dimensional optimizer pairs are not completely classified. Historical source overlap remains possible; no independent audit has been performed.
title: Exact two-ball covering of regular simplices and a parity rigidity transition
